# Agent Memory

> Long-term memory for AI agents: episodic, semantic, and procedural memory in SQLite, a write path that extracts and versions facts, a hybrid retriever that explains every result, a consolidation job that summarizes and forgets, and a Model Context Protocol server so it plugs into Claude Desktop or VS Code.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory

## Source

- [src/agent_memory/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/__init__.py): Long-term memory for AI agents.
- [src/agent_memory/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/cli.py): Command-line interface: ``agent-memory add | recall | consolidate | stats | ...
- [src/agent_memory/consolidation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/consolidation.py): Consolidation: summarize old episodes into semantic memory, then forget by decay.
- [src/agent_memory/embedding.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/embedding.py): Embedding interface and a deterministic feature-hashing embedder built on numpy.
- [src/agent_memory/evaluation/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/evaluation/__init__.py): Benchmark harness and synthetic dataset.
- [src/agent_memory/evaluation/dataset.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/evaluation/dataset.py): Deterministic synthetic multi-session dialogue dataset with temporal ground truth.
- [src/agent_memory/evaluation/harness.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/evaluation/harness.py): Benchmark harness: memory conditions, retrieval ablations, and scaling measurements.
- [src/agent_memory/extraction.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/extraction.py): Candidate extraction: turn a conversation turn into candidate facts and preferences.
- [src/agent_memory/fake_provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/fake_provider.py): Deterministic offline provider for tests and continuous integration.
- [src/agent_memory/mcp_server.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/mcp_server.py): Model Context Protocol server exposing memory tools to MCP clients.
- [src/agent_memory/memory.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/memory.py): The public facade: a namespace-scoped long-term memory for one user or agent.
- [src/agent_memory/merge.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/merge.py): Write-path deduplication and conflict resolution for facts and preferences.
- [src/agent_memory/models.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/models.py): Typed records for the three memory kinds and for retrieval results.
- [src/agent_memory/provider.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/provider.py): Language-model provider interface and a Claude implementation.
- [src/agent_memory/scoring.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/scoring.py): The hybrid retrieval score and its per-result explanations.
- [src/agent_memory/settings.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/settings.py): Tunable settings for scoring, fact merging, consolidation, and forgetting.
- [src/agent_memory/store.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/store.py): SQLite persistence: memories, FTS5 lexical index, vector table, and namespace isolation.
- [src/agent_memory/text.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-memory/blob/main/src/agent_memory/text.py): Tokenization and normalization shared by extraction, embedding, and lexical search.
